promise: Pass comprehensive health care reform legislation in 2009
description: In a joint session address Obama told Congress reform 'must happen this year.' The Affordable Care Act was not signed until March 23, 2010, several months after the promised timeline.
evidence: Reform did ultimately pass, fulfilling the substance of the promise

review.note: March 23, 2010 signing supported. September 9 attribution of 'must happen this year' and the exact year-end deadline need the speech. If confirmed, kept (delayed) is more consistent than partial.

promise: The Bali Action Plan directed its working group to complete its work in 2009 and present an agreed outcome to COP15.
description: COP15 extended the working group's mandate instead of completing the process in 2009. The Bali decision did not expressly guarantee a legally binding treaty.
evidence: Decision 1/CP.15 extends the working group's mandate; the Accord is a separate decision.

review.note: The Bali decision calls for an agreed outcome and completion of the working group's work in 2009, not expressly a legally binding treaty. COP15's decision extends that group's mandate, while the Accord is only noted. December 18 was a scheduled endpoint; the meeting continued into December 19. The original Bali adoption UTC date still needs confirmation.
